text:
Tristan Luneau played one NHL game last season and is now playing 20 minutes a night for Anaheim, and he has been one of the season's quiet surprises. The Athletic put him on a list of eight rising players under 23. He has four goals and 14 points in 24 games, and the Ducks take 54% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), 14 points better than without him, on a club that is under water overall.

Treat it with some care. His goals run ahead of his chances, four on about two expected, and before this season the samples on him were tiny. Evolving-Hockey's only read was 125 minutes in 2023-24. But a second-round pick who scored 83 points as a QMJHL defenseman in 2022-23 now has a real NHL role, and he has been setting up Cutter Gauthier, a good job to have in Anaheim right now. Our range has him around 44 points.
